column1: # Recorded escapes for backlog-164's gate: a RESOLVED CodeRabbit finding whose fix
# Format, tab-separated, all three fields mandatory and non-blank:
# The id is the `cr-comment:v1:<hex>` marker in the finding's body — line numbers
# are NOT usable as a key (the API returns `line: null`).
# Legitimate reasons exist: a doc/comment correction, or a finding you REFUTED
# rather than fixed. They just have to be written down. A blank reason or a blank
# owner is a usage error (exit 2), not an excuse — the silent skip is the thing
# Empty of entries on purpose: nothing has needed one yet.
